authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES an execution-remainder join for DR-101 obligations recorded on distribution-core-inventory-contract.v16. It does not close leftover-design. It does not make D-056 gates 2 or 3 hold. It does not add a DR-G* row. It does not change required-now 26. It does not decide OD-101-1 or OD-101-2. It applies nothing, marks nothing SATISFIED, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.

obligations.reason: v16 specifies threeCores, defaultInstall, and inventorySchema. Remainder is G01-G05 execution and measurement. Those identifiers are already named (D-086/D-088/D-102). This join does not retarget those namings.
The acceptance-cell harness remainder is the same five named identifiers. Naming is not execution. Not authored. Not QUALIFIED.
v16 inventorySchema.everyReleaseMustPublish is specified. Qualitative TCB identity remains DR-126 / G22 (v16 ID-DEP-K2). This join does not retarget G22.
v16 inventorySchema.layerTaxonomy and graphRules specify layering. Remainder is published-inventory measurement at the named core gates.

Core implementation language is RESERVED on v16. G01-G05 measure size, startup, memory, and component delta. They do not own a language choice. G13 is language-quality for supported analyzer roles, not core-language selection. This join does not mint Rust-as-core.

v16 extracts signing ROLES and reserves ceremony/thresholds/notarization. G01-G05 do not own OS notarization or code-signing ceremony. DR-112 recovery ceremony and DR-110 repair-media trust remain adjacent, not owners.
v16 platforms are specified as the D-002 four-platform set. Remainder is per-platform G01-G05 measurement. This join does not change D-002 platforms.

doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone: This candidate does not make DR-101 D-056-eligible. OD-101-1 and OD-101-2 remain leftover-design. Gates 2 and 3 do not hold for DR-101. Class A is not opened. D-159's gates-2/3 holding for DR-117 is not retargeted.
